extracted.name: Fresh Raspberry Balsamic Vinaigrette
extracted.description: This raspberry vinaigrette is easy to make with fresh raspberries, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, and honey for a quick, summer salad dressing.
instruction_lines: Mix raspberries and sugar together in a bowl; set aside until mixture is juicy, about 10 minutes. Mash raspberries using a fork until liquefied.
Pour raspberry mixture into a clean jar with a lid; add vinegar, oil, honey, and salt. Cover the jar with a lid and shake until dressing is mixed well. Store in the refrigerator.
